from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialExpenseRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial expense data from a single document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company the financial statement belongs to")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for the financial statement")
    expense_category: str | None = Field(description="The label of the expense line item (e.g., 'General and administrative expenses')")
    amount: str | None = Field(description="The reported amount for the expense category as a string (e.g., '$1,911 thousand')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    expense_records: list[FinancialExpenseRecord]
